feat(poly-robot): add canary rollout readiness certification

outcomes: E1 complete: CI now enforces rollout rehearsal protocol status and uploads deterministic rehearsal artifacts.
E2 complete: rollout rehearsal runner executes precheck/postcheck command bundles with structured results and rollout-blocking metadata on failures.
E3 complete: canary readiness certification runner and policy artifact now emit weighted PASS/FAIL criteria, blockers, and explicit manual approval/rollback authority boundaries.

session_learnings.learning: Rehearsal gating and readiness certification should remain separate artifacts: operational health gate first, then promotion-readiness gate.
session_learnings.action: Keep `run_rollout_rehearsal.py` and `run_canary_readiness_certification.py` as explicit sequential pipeline steps.

session_learnings.learning: Promotion safety requires explicit distinction between technical readiness PASS and manual approval authorization.
session_learnings.action: Preserve `promotion_decision` metadata with `manual_approval_required` and `canary_enablement_allowed` fields as non-optional outputs.

carry_over_workspace_state.note: Poly-Robot workspace is clean at phase handoff; next-phase kickoff can proceed directly from tracked artifacts.
